title: A cloud reviewer's verdict file: .review/<pr>-<nonce8>.json (refuter: .review/refute-<pr>-<nonce8>-<n>.json)
description: Contract (PR f0) for the one file a cloud reviewer or refuter commits and pushes, and `scripts/ledger.py fetch-verdict` reads (PR f4, tier 2; docs/specs/factory.md 2.2 'Launch, cloud review' and 'Review record'). The channel, in order: `scripts/factory/review_cloud.py` makes a 128-bit nonce (`secrets.token_hex(16)`, 32 lowercase hex characters, kept only in the launch record and in that reviewer's prompt), pushes the PR's head sha to `refs/heads/review/<pr>-<nonce8>` (nonce8 is the first 8 characters of the nonce) and launches the reviewer on that branch. The reviewer commits exactly this one file, as a child of `head_sha`, pushes only that branch, and ends its session with the line `VERDICT: PASS|FIX|BLOCK at <40-hex sha>` (a refuter: `CONFIRMED`, `REFUTED` or `UNPROVEN`). FILE NAME: a pr-reviewer writes `.review/<pr>-<nonce8>.json`; a refuter writes `.review/refute-<pr>-<nonce8>-<n>.json` where `n` counts the refuter's claims from 1. READ: `fetch-verdict` runs `git fetch origin review/<pr>-<nonce8>` and records the verdict only if all of these hold: the tip's parent is `head_sha`; the tip changes exactly the one verdict path; the file's `nonce` equals the launch record's nonce; the file's `head_sha` equals the PR's current head (`gh pr view --json headRefOid`), and the head did not move during the review; the file's `pr` equals the PR. Then it deletes the review branch as a subprocess. Words are public: no drawing text, no key. A verdict file is advice to the local ledger: it can say PASS, but `merge_ready` still needs the ledger's record and CI. A PR comment or a Remote Control message is never a verdict.

head_sha.description: The PR head reviewed; the parent of the review branch's tip.

nonce.description: The full 128-bit nonce from the prompt, as 32 lowercase hex characters.

findings.description: A pr-reviewer's findings, in public words. A refuter writes [] (its claim and answer are in its verdict and the review branch's commit message).

score.description: The reviewer's score; 50 or more needs a refuter before it reaches the builder.

file.description: A repository path (never a drawing's name).

line.description: The line in the new file; 0 when the finding is about the file as a whole.

summary.description: One or two sentences: the failing scenario. Public words.
